raw_sections.skills:
Key strengths:
	Agentic AI & Prompt Engineering: Designed autonomous NLP workflows that self-evaluate and retrain, improving accuracy from 70% to 100% within 5 iterations. (Refer my Linkedin post)
	AWS and Azure ML Deployment Expertise: Full lifecycle deployments (workspace/resource group setup, environment creation, component registration, pipeline orchestration, traffic routing, and API validation) using SDK/CLI, FastAPI scoring, JSON-ready outputs, and Postman testing.
	NLP & LLM Engineering: GPT-3.5, GPT-4o, Meta LLaMA-3 feedback systems; multi-label classification pipelines with scikit-learn.
	EdTech AI Leadership: Built adaptive learning, hybrid recommendation systems, and AI tools at Be10x.in, training 600+ learners in applied AI.
Self-Built independent AI Tools/Solutions: (Refer my LinkedIn Posts for further info with code)
Agentic AI Demo – Built an autonomous agent in Python to monitor NLP model accuracy, trigger GridSearchCV retraining, and report improvements for automated ML lifecycle management.
LangChain CSV Chatbot – Developed a chatbot using LangChain (CLI & Streamlit UI) for querying CSV datasets interactively, enabling non-technical users to explore data conversationally.
Agentic Preprocessor – Created an AI-powered preprocessing tool in Python to automate data cleaning and feature preparation decisions, reducing manual effort in ML pipelines.
HIGHLIGHTS/ACHIEVEMENTS
	Sole Data Science/ML lead at Adeption, driving all AI/ML initiatives from setup to production deployment.
	Designed Recommendation Engine using Ada embeddings (ClientId-aware), achieving 89.5% semantic accuracy and reducing manual effort by 90%.
	Productionized Action Tagging Pipeline (10-tag multi-label NLP classifier) using HashingVectorizer + ClassifierChain, deployed on Azure Managed Online Endpoints.
	Delivered Actionability Tagging Models (What/Why/When) to evaluate action plan quality; improved leadership plan assessment accuracy through upsampling and Azure ML Designer pipelines.
	Developed Big Challenge Tagging System using TF-IDF + Logistic Regression with threshold tuning; boosted F1- score through GridSearchCV optimization, deployed with JSON-ready outputs.
	Delivered AI-powered Coach Feedback pipelines using GPT-3.5, GPT-4o-mini, and LLaMA-3, producing structured coaching insights at scale.
	Published research, walkthroughs, and thought leadership on Medium/LinkedIn recognized for practical AI translation.
TECHNICAL SKILLS
ML & NLP: Random Forest, XGBoost, Logistic Regression, ClassifierChain, TF-IDF, HashingVectorizer, Ada Embeddings, GPT-3.5/4o, Meta LLaMA-3.
Deployment & Cloud: AWS & Azure ML Pipelines, Managed Online Endpoints, Azure OpenAI, FastAPI, Postman, Azure Blob Storage.
Programming	&	Tools:	Python,	SQL,	GitHub,	Jupyter,	Tableau,	Pandas,	NumPy,	Scikit-learn.
Earlier Tech (Mainframes): COBOL, JCL, DB2, VSAM (summarized).

JOHN DANIEL BAKHT SINGH A
Reference:
PROJECT HI-LIGHTS

1. Recommendation System (Adeption) – Built an AI-powered semantic engine that recommends the most relevant leadership tools based on user reflections. Leveraged Azure OpenAI Ada embeddings + cosine similarity with ClientId-aware filtering to ensure personalized and context-specific recommendations. Automated mapping of qualitative feedback to tools reduced manual curation by 90%, improving platform scalability.

Roles: Designed core architecture, implemented Azure ML pipeline for embedding generation and scoring, engineered ClientId filters, optimized token management, and deployed JSON-ready outputs for seamless UI integration.

2. Action Tagging Pipeline (Adeption) – Built an AI-driven multi-label NLP pipeline to automatically tag user reflections into 10 leadership themes. Implemented feature hashing + classifier chain ensembles, achieving
~0.65 F1 score. Deployed as an Azure Managed Online Endpoint with FastAPI + JSON-ready outputs for real- time consumption.
Roles: Designed pipeline (data prep, vectorization, model training), deployed via Azure ML (SDK/CLI), authored scoring API, and validated predictions in Postman.

3. Actionability Tagging Models (Adeption) – Designed AI models to evaluate leadership action plans across three dimensions: What, Why, and When. Trained on 2,777 manually scored actions, the models transformed free-text plans into structured, dimension-level scores, giving leaders real-time feedback on clarity, purpose, and timelines. Addressed class imbalance with upsampling to improve recall for underrepresented cases.

Roles: Built binary classification pipeline with hashed feature extraction + classifier chains, performed text cleaning/normalization, optimized models in Azure ML (Designer & SDK), and packaged outputs for easy integration

4. Big Challenge Tagging (Adeption) – Developed an AI pipeline to automatically tag employee “Big Challenge” submissions into multiple business themes, replacing manual review with a scalable solution. Implemented TF- IDF + One-vs-Rest Logistic Regression with threshold tuning, improving micro F1 performance. Deployed on Azure ML Managed Online Endpoint with JSON-ready API for real-time insights .

Roles: Designed end-to-end pipeline (data cleaning, TF-IDF features, logistic regression training), applied GridSearchCV + threshold optimization, built custom score.py for API output, deployed via Azure ML (SDK/CLI), and validated predictions with Postman .
5. Adaptive Learning Platform (Be10x) – Personalized learning paths using Random Forest, validated by A/B testing.
EDUCATION & CREDENTIALS
